source.title: GQA: Training Generalized Multi-Query Transformer Models from Multi-Head Checkpoints

license.changes: Cropped from the original figure. Source colors and geometry are preserved.

teaching.spokenAnchor: Multi-head attention stores eight key-value pairs for eight query heads. GQA stores an intermediate count, two in this example. Multi-query attention stores one shared pair for all eight.
teaching.moment: Trace one query group into a shared K/V pair across the MHA, GQA and MQA layouts.
teaching.scope: The source drawing has four GQA groups for eight queries; the lesson’s toy uses two. Do not transfer its group count to the toy byte calculation.
teaching.caption: This source example has eight queries and four KV groups; the lesson toy uses two groups.
